provenance: Source declarations observed 2026-09-21; declarative motion parameters only, not application source. Apply in source order, then scoped charcoal overrides. Unused historical CSS selectors may appear; behavior ownership and activation are defined in 04-ui-motion.md.

values.transition-property: transform, color, background-color, border-color, box-shadow, outline-color

rules.selector:
.app-shell :is(input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']):not([type='file']), textarea, select),
.golden-picker select,
.ledger-modal :is(input:not([type='file']), textarea, select),
.dashboard-modal textarea

values.transition:
border-color var(--motion-state) var(--motion-ease),
    background-color var(--motion-state) var(--motion-ease),
    box-shadow var(--motion-state) var(--motion-ease),
    outline-color var(--motion-fast) var(--motion-ease)

transform var(--motion-state) var(--motion-ease),
    border-color var(--motion-state) var(--motion-ease),
    background-color var(--motion-state) var(--motion-ease),
    box-shadow var(--motion-state) var(--motion-ease)

translate var(--motion-state) var(--motion-ease),
    color var(--motion-state) var(--motion-ease),
    border-color var(--motion-state) var(--motion-ease),
    background-color var(--motion-state) var(--motion-ease)

rules.selector:
.app-shell :is(.file-row, .file-type, .review-item, .item-status, .verdict-badge,
  .criteria-card, .criteria-type, .analysis-file, .analysis-status, .analysis-phase-list > li,
  .analysis-section-heading > span, .analysis-log-state, .criteria-log-state, .analysis-inventory li,
  .analysis-regions > li, .extracted-field, .extracted-field-value),
.golden-picker :is(.golden-picker-entry, .golden-picker-marker, .golden-picker-entry-description),
.ledger-modal :is(.ledger-status-chip, .ledger-cell-address, .ledger-new-value),
.dashboard-modal :is(.dashboard-suggestion, .dashboard-stages li, .dashboard-stage-icon,
  .dashboard-sandbox-steps li, .dashboard-sandbox-step-icon, .dashboard-log-status,
  .dashboard-preview-dot)

values.transition:
color var(--motion-state) var(--motion-ease),
    background-color var(--motion-state) var(--motion-ease),
    border-color var(--motion-state) var(--motion-ease),
    box-shadow var(--motion-state) var(--motion-ease)

opacity var(--motion-state) var(--motion-ease),
    transform var(--motion-state) var(--motion-ease)

rules.selector:
.app-shell .understood-criteria > button > svg:last-child,
.extracted-fields-chevron,
.criteria-card-toggle > svg:last-child,
.criteria-discovery > summary > svg:last-child,
.criteria-activity > summary > svg:last-child,
.analysis-activity-toggle > svg:last-child,
.dashboard-activity-chevron

values.transition:
color var(--motion-fast) var(--motion-ease),
    border-color var(--motion-fast) var(--motion-ease),
    background-color var(--motion-fast) var(--motion-ease),
    box-shadow var(--motion-fast) var(--motion-ease)

opacity var(--motion-fast) var(--motion-ease),
    transform var(--motion-state) var(--motion-ease)
